welcome.text: This is a short guide to the queue desk: the screen volunteers use to call guests up on market day.

open.text: On your phone, open the queue screen and sign in with your volunteer account.

before.text: Guests register from their own phones, then the lottery is drawn. Until then, the screen waits.

tour.text: When service starts, the line appears. Waiting lists everyone in line, in the order they’ll be called.

row.text: Each row shows the guest’s number, their name, and the language they speak, so you can greet them in it.

sections.text: Further down, Not placed lists guests who weren’t drawn today, and Done fills up as you serve people.

display.text: The room display shows the same line, but only numbers, never names.

call.text: When you’re ready for the next guest, tap Call next.

called.text: Their number goes up on the room display, and their phone tells them it’s their turn.

ticket.text: Their ticket opens on your screen, with a clock counting from the moment you called them.

tag.text: The name tag shows their first name and last initial, their number, and their language.

print.text: Tap Print name tag, and it prints at the print station, on the market’s computer.

offline.text: If the print station is offline, the button says so. Write the tag by hand instead.

serve.text: When the guest has checked in, tap Serve and call next. That finishes their visit and calls the next guest, in one step.

rhythm.text: The next ticket opens in its place, so the line moves with one tap per guest.

together.text: If two volunteers are calling at once, each tap calls a different guest. Nobody is called twice.

late.text: Sometimes a guest isn’t there yet. Don’t hold up the line. Close their ticket, and call the next guest.

lateWaits.text: They stay in Called, showing the minutes since you called them. On their phone, the number slowly turns yellow, asking them to come to the check-in desk.

lateServe.text: When they arrive, tap their row, and choose Mark served. That doesn’t call anyone new, so the line stays where it is.

noShow.text: If someone you called a while ago still hasn’t come, you can mark them as a no-show. They move to a list of their own.

returnBack.text: If they turn up later, open their ticket and tap Return to back of line. They keep their number.

returnFront.text: The arrow beside it puts them at the front instead, for a guest you called by mistake.

add.text: To put someone in line yourself, tap Add guest, beside Waiting.

addForm.text: Enter their details, choose Give them a spot, and pick where they go: the end of the queue, or next up.

addPriority.text: Someone you put next up gets a P number, like P1, so nobody else’s number changes.

qr.text: Then tap Show QR code for their phone. When they scan it with their camera, their phone follows their place in line.

phone.text: Need to reach a guest? Phone, on their ticket, calls them. And History shows who called and served them, and when.

finish.text: When everyone has been through, Call next turns into Close session.

close.text: Tap it and confirm to end the day. The menu at the top can close the session early, too: if anyone is still waiting or called, it says how many, because closing marks them as no-shows.

thanks.text: That’s the queue desk. Thank you for helping every neighbor get served.
